title: Glowing red car
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='42' ry='20' fill='#ff2200' opacity='0.18'/>
  <!-- shadow underneath -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='33' ry='7' fill='#4a1010'/>
  <!-- car body main -->
  <rect x='12' y='48' width='76' height='28' rx='10' fill='#e02020'/>
  <!-- lighter body highlight -->
  <rect x='16' y='51' width='68' height='8' rx='5' fill='#ff6b4a'/>
  <!-- cabin roof -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q32 30 44 28 L62 28 Q72 30 74 48 Z' fill='#c41818'/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <path d='M34 46 Q36 33 44 31 L48 31 L48 46 Z' fill='#5ac8fa'/>
  <path d='M52 46 L52 31 L60 31 Q68 33 70 46 Z' fill='#5ac8fa'/>
  <!-- window shine -->
  <path d='M36 44 L40 35 L43 35 L39 44 Z' fill='#bdeeff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- headlights -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='58' r='5' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- taillight -->
  <rect x='12' y='55' width='5' height='9' rx='2' fill='#ff9a66'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='10' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='5' fill='#8a8aa0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='76' r='10' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='76' r='5' fill='#8a8aa0'/>
  <!-- wheel highlights -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='3' fill='#c0c0d0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='76' r='3' fill='#c0c0d0'/>
  <!-- bumper/front detail -->
  <rect x='80' y='64' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff8c66'/>
  <rect x='12' y='64' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff8c66'/>
  <!-- side mirror -->
  <ellipse cx='77' cy='46' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff6b4a'/>
</svg>
